Files are read in this browser only. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is remembered after you close the folder or reload.

Your browser will now ask “Upload N files to this site?”. That wording is the browser’s own and cannot be changed by a page; the files only get read here, they are not sent anywhere.

  • Paste a link or choose a file from your device.
  • Playlists and streams (m3u, m3u8, pls, xspf, asx, mp3, aac, mp4 …) open in the player; images, text, PDF and zip/tar open in the viewer.
  • A link from another site must allow reading from other sites (CORS), otherwise download the file and choose it here.
